name: Mirrorwing Dragon
oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever a player casts an instant or sorcery spell that targets only this creature, that player copies that spell for each other creature they control that the spell could target. Each copy targets a different one of those creatures.
blocked_sentences: Whenever a player casts an instant or sorcery spell that targets only this creature, that player copies that spell for each other creature they control that the spell could target. Each copy targets a different one of those creatures.

needs.what: an op that copies the triggering spell once for each other object that spell could legally target (here: each other creature the caster controls), with the copies controlled by the spell's caster and each copy's single target set to a different one of those objects (the Precursor Golem / Ink-Treader Nephilim / Zada / Radiate pattern)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: copy_spell takes amount, controller and new_targets, but new_targets lets the copier choose new targets freely; nothing iterates over the spell's legal targets and binds each copy to a distinct one, and for_each cannot pass its loop object into a copy's target

needs.what: a spell_cast trigger filter matching an instant or sorcery spell whose every target is this permanent (a single target, the source), with the caster of that spell bound as the copying player
needs.why_existing_wont_do: spell_cast's trigger_filter_keys read the spell's own characteristics, not its targets; becomes_target with targeted_by fires on any spell or ability that targets this creature among others and on copies, so it cannot say 'casts ... that targets only this creature'
